name: secure-git-bridge
description: Secure, human-controlled repository access through Secure Git Bridge.
long_description: Secure Git Bridge gives Claude access only to a repository that a local human explicitly binds in the Secure Git Bridge app. The extension itself receives no repository path or repository broker credential. Claude can use only the bounded read/status/diff/propose tools exposed by Secure Git Bridge; protected files remain blocked and Apply remains human-only.

pairing.title: Secure Git Bridge pairing
pairing.description: In Secure Git Bridge, open Claude and choose Connect or Reopen Claude Connector Setup, then paste the copied pairing value here. This value authenticates only the Claude provider connector; repository access still requires an explicit local Bind action in Secure Git Bridge.
